# current_fields

A view. rank-1 field_values — the current value per (identity, field), value still JSON-encoded.

## Columns

`identity_id`, `field`, `value`, `source`, `confidence`, `run_id`, `created_at`.

## Definition

From `spec/ledger.sql`, which is the machine-checkable form of SPEC.md §3:

```sql
CREATE VIEW current_fields AS
SELECT identity_id, field, value, source, confidence, run_id, created_at
FROM field_value_ranks
WHERE rank = 1;
```
